help.intro: Twelve sentences about a weekend — a question, ten events in the Perfekt, and a closing 'Es war …' — to listen to and repeat, then to rebuild with your own weekend in them. The point is the frame: haben or sein in second place, participle at the very end, with a time word to set the scene first: Am Samstag habe ich lange geschlafen. It is the answer to the first question of every Monday — 'Was hast du am Wochenende gemacht?' — and a listener notices three things: the right helper verb (habe / bin), the participle at the end, and time words that give the story an order (dann, danach, am Abend, später, zum Schluss).
help.tips[0].title: Time word first, helper second, participle last
help.tips[0].text: Am Samstag | habe | ich meine Freunde | getroffen. Say the time, then the helper, then everything else, then the participle — and stop.
help.tips[0].examples[1].en: After that I went into town.
help.tips[0].check.why: Time first, then the helper habe, then the rest — and the participle gespielt last.
help.tips[1].title: The story words
help.tips[1].text: dann (then), danach (after that), später (later), am Abend (in the evening), zum Schluss (finally). Each one takes position 1 and pulls the verb after it: Dann habe ich …, Später habe ich …, Zum Schluss habe ich …
help.tips[1].examples[0].en: Then I had a leisurely breakfast. Later I called my parents.
help.tips[1].check.why: später takes position 1, so the verb comes straight after it and the subject moves behind: Später bin ich …
help.tips[2].title: habe or bin — decide before you start the sentence
help.tips[2].text: If the verb is movement or change (gehen, fahren, kommen, aufstehen), the sentence starts with bin. Decide it first, and the rest flows.
help.tips[2].examples[0].en: I went into town. I met friends.
help.tips[2].examples[1].en: We went to a restaurant. We watched a film.
help.tips[2].check.q: Am Abend ____ ich mit meinem Hund spazieren gegangen.
help.tips[2].check.why: gehen is movement, so the helper is bin — decide that before you start the sentence.
help.remember[0]: Am Samstag – habe – ich – … – gemacht: five beats, participle on the last.
help.remember[1]: Stack the story with dann, danach, später, zum Schluss.
help.exam: Telling someone about your weekend is a classic A2 speaking task in the exam — and the first question you hear every Monday.
help.hook: „Was hast du am Wochenende gemacht?“ — answer Monday's favourite question with a little story told in the right order.
phrases[2].translation: Then I had a leisurely breakfast.
phrases[3].translation: After that I went into town.
phrases[5].translation: We went to a restaurant together.
phrases[6].translation: In the evening we watched a film.
phrases[7].translation: On Sunday I stayed at home.
